name: The Skyland Chronicles
description:
About This Game

Embrace the curse as a pirate, growing ever more formidable with each tarot power you seize, even as your humanity slips away like sand through your fingers. A DARK FANTASY PIRATE GAME.

BECOME A CURSED PIRATE

Slip into Franco’s battered boots, an orphan adrift on the Old Harlot in a dark fantasy pirate soulslike. Battle for those you cherish, unleash forbidden tarot powers, and shape your ship’s destiny, all while each death pulls you closer to monstrous transformation.

EVERY EXPEDITION DRAGS YOU DEEPER INTO THE CURSE

Siren spirits try to deceive you, offering power for the price of your soul. But your medallion, the only proof that you once belonged to someone, turns those curses into your weapon. Collect tarot cards, grow your build, and uncover secrets like a pirate king carving his way down the Grand Line.

THIS ISN'T AN ADVENTURE FOR EVERYONE

Every fight could spell your doom. Unleash savage saber combos, crushing fists, and thunderous gauntlet shots. Master enemy patterns, parry with razor precision, and survive by instinct and perfect timing. Confront relentless foes and towering bosses, finishing them with ruthless flair.

WITHOUT A CREW, YOU'RE DEAD

Guard your crew’s spirit and strength, for they hold the keys to shops, services, and your own growth. Careful planning in the bustling hub gives you an edge, but neglecting your crew turns every voyage into a desperate struggle.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Four adrenaline-fueled expeditions
    Plunge into Franco’s shadowy journey, tracing his path from the first taste of the curse to his ultimate metamorphosis.

  • Soulslike combat
    Build your own combinations of saber, fists, and gauntlet shots, learn enemy behavior, and parry at the perfect moment.

  • Eight merciless bosses and ten enemy types that won't forgive even the smallest slip.

  • Tarot card system. Collect cards, craft unique builds, and turn cursed powers into deadly weapons.

  • Twelve mystic tarot card abilities to unlock and chain into devastating combos.

  • Manage your crew
    Keep morale up and grow their stats to open new shops and services and upgrade your character.

  • Explore a sprawling hub alive with energy, overflowing with fresh shops and a trove of crew resources.

  • Enter the bare-knuckle arena or plunge into the savage, drunken brawl mode, where brutality reaches its fever pitch.

  • Use a grappling hook, parkour moves, and a dynamic shooting system to enjoy complete freedom of movement during combat.

  • A "Dead or Alive" mode for daredevils who want to play for everything.
